subject.title: fix(cli): one-shot agent --local runs never export OTel diagnostics

question: Should OpenClaw accept starting and flushing the configured OTel exporter in the short-lived embedded CLI process, including Gateway-fallback runs, after reviewing the current-main merge result?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes process lifecycle and shutdown behavior for existing OTel-enabled CLI setups; the protected member-authored PR requires a human owner to accept that operational tradeoff.

options.title: Approve the scoped lifecycle
options.body: Accept OTel export for embedded runs after rebasing or reviewing the clean merge result and confirming the focused lifecycle coverage still passes.

options.title: Keep OTel Gateway-only
options.body: Reject the new embedded-process exporter lifecycle if maintaining the former process boundary is preferable to local-run telemetry parity.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped lifecycle
recommendation.body: Accept OTel export for embedded runs after rebasing or reviewing the clean merge result and confirming the focused lifecycle coverage still passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent implementation and fallback-resolution commits make this contributor the closest available routing contact for the lifecycle design.
